content: Xoossi Nohera Gelida Caaqo Qaala
Xoossi Nohenne iza nayta, «Yelettite; corattite; biitta ubbaa kumite.
Biitta do7ati, kafoti, biittan woxxi qaaxxiza miishshatinne abba giddon diza moleti wuri inttes yayettonne dagammetto; istti intte shenen detto.
Ta inttes biittafe mokkiza dumma dumma kaththata immida malakka shemppora paxa diza medheteththati wuri inttes quma gidana.
Shemppoy suuththa giddon diza gishshas suuththi izappe gukkontta asho moopite.
Tani intte shemppoy izan diza intte suuth meheppenne do7a ubbaafe tumu ta oychchana; qasse asa ubbaafekka iza mala asa suuth oychchana.
Xoossi as bana misatissidi medhdhida gishshas asa suuth gussiza oonakka gidikko iza suuththika asa kushen gukkana.
Intte yelettite; corattitenne; biitta bolla keehi darite» gi anjjides.
Hessafe guye Xoossi Nohenne izara diza iza nayta hizgides;

«Histtiin ha7i tani ta caaqo inttenara, inttefe guye intte zereththaranne nenara shemppora diza medheteththatara caaqettadis; ee! Tani ta caaqo kafora, mehera, biitta do7a ubbaaranne markabeppe inttenara kezida paxa diza medheteth ubbaara caaqettadis.
Tani inttenara caaqettadis; hayssafe sinththan paxa dizay wuri dhayssiza haaththan mulekka dhayenna; ha biittaa dhayssiza haaththi hayssafe guye mulekka deenna» gides.
Qasseka Xoossi, «Tani taappenne inttefe, inttenara diza paxa medheteththatas ubbaafe giddon yaana yeleta ubbaara caaqettiza caaqozas malatay hayssa;
tani ta zuulla salo bolla essana; izi taappenne ha biitta bolla diza medheteththafe giddon diza caaqozas malata gidana.
Tani biittafe bollan shaara ehida wodenne shaara bollan zuullay beettida wode,

‹Paxa diza medheteth ubbaa dhayssanaas hayssafe sinththan mulekka dhayssa haaththi yeenna› gaada taappenne inttefe paxa diza dumma dumma qommo medheteththata ubbaafe giddon caaqqida ta qaalaa ta qoppana.

Zuullay shaara bolla beettida wode aydekka tani iza beyada taappe Xoossaafenne ha biittaa bollan paxa diza dumma dumma qommo medheteththa ubbaafe giddon caaqo gelida mernaa caaqo qaalaa ta hassa7ana» gides.
Xoossi Nohe, «Tani taappenne ha biitta bollan paxa diza ubbaafe giddon caaqqida caaqozas malatay hayssa» gides.
Nohenne Iza Nayta
Markabezappe kezida Nohe nayti Seeme, Kaamenne Yaafeete; Kaamey Kanaane aawa.
Hayti heedzdzayka Nohe nayta; biitta ubbaan diza asay isttafe yelettides.
Nohey goshshanchcha; izi woyne mith toketh oykkides.
Issi gallas izi woyneppe oosettida cajje uyi maththottidi ba Dunkaaneza giddon paxa kallo ichchides.
Kanaane aawa Kaamey ba aawaa kalloteth be7idi kare kezidi ba ishata nam7atas yootides.

Gido attiin Seemeynne Yaafeetey may7o ekkidi nam7ayka ba hashe hashe bolla gaththi oykkidi gundiguth hemetti gelidi ba aawa kalloteth kammida; istti ba aawaa kalloteth be7ontta mala ba ayfeso guye zaarida.
Nohey maththoy aadhdhiin beeggidi ubbaafe kaalo naazi ba bolla ooththidayssa eridi,
Qasseka Nohey,
Dhayssa haaththafe guye Nohey 350 layth de7ides.
Nohey mulera 950 layth deyidi hayqqides.

footnotes.text: Yaafeete: Yaafeete guussi aasso guussa misatees.
